method.documentReview: Compared source facts, proposed Egret recommendations, version boundaries and unexecuted acceptance claims.
method.sourceReview: Re-read eight pinned source files through the GitHub connector; re-resolved six annotated release tags to commit SHA.

confirmedSourceFacts.fact: updateTextures combines old and new characters when a missing character exists; _renderAtlas remeasures, clears/repositions glyphs, uploads every retained atlas page and emits render. This is not append-only placement or proof of LRU.

confirmedSourceFacts.topic: Babylon dirty rectangle versus GPU upload
confirmedSourceFacts.fact: The inspected ThinEngine dynamic-texture implementation calls texImage2D with the full source and exposes no dirty-rectangle upload argument. CPU dirty-region drawing does not prove local GPU upload; no claim for uninspected WebGPU or native paths.

Babylon caches _FontHeightSizes by CSS font string; _resetFontCache marks a control dirty without clearing that global map. Pixi managed text textures use styleKey and usageCount. fontEpoch/fontAsset/contentHash invalidation is an Egret proposal, not a verified common upstream API.

Three resetState resets its tracked render target, WebGL state and binding states. Babylon wipeCaches(bruteForce) explicitly targets shared-context use and invalidates its caches. One library reset does not synchronize another library's independent cache; both need a defined handoff.

Three r180 iterates extensionsUsed; its default branch warns when the same name is in extensionsRequired and has no registered plugin. This is not a universal rule for every required-extension error: required KHR_texture_basisu without an injected KTX2Loader throws.

CanvasTextPipe subscribes to contextChange, unloads managed texts and regenerates them on the next render because pooled canvases are reused. This does not prove actual Egret font availability or restoration.

findings.issue: NFC text as an unconditional cache-key input could silently change original business/input text.
findings.resolution: The formal document requires raw text authority, forbids unilateral normalization and preserves original text if an explicit normalization policy is needed.
findings.remainingNote: If the work markdown is published later, align its NFC wording with the formal policy.

boundaries: No reference engine, upstream test, new probe, real-font/CJK/emoji/IME matrix or actual asset was executed.
Source APIs and browser Canvas support do not establish text correctness across fonts, devices or non-DOM hosts.
No mobile/mini-game/native host, performance, power, memory, package size, GPU capture or integration acceptance is claimed.
Asset ownership, animation and compression conclusions are scoped to inspected entry points; deeper WorkerPool, shader and controller implementations were not independently expanded in this review.
License text and recorded obligations remain preliminary reuse evidence; dependencies, fonts, assets, decoder binaries and actual distribution models need their own review.
This AI review is not human approval, final production selection or comprehensive security/source audit.
